newsitem.title: CANADA: Moore sees Q2, yr EPS below estimates.
newsitem.headline: Moore sees Q2, yr EPS below estimates.

text.p: Moore Corp said on Wednesday it anticipated that its second-quarter and full-year earnings would be lower than analysts' expectations.
Moore said it did not expect to achieve analysts' average earnings per share estimate of US$1.45 for the full year.
The business forms company said results in its industry throughout North America were weaker than anticipated.
The company said that price discounting and falling volumes had weakened its business, but that volume declines were less severe in April and May.
